plan.title: Melanoma anti-PD-1 immune/stromal deconvolution from TPM
plan.analytical_narrative: The core delivered gene-level Salmon TPM only (12000 genes x 12 samples: 6 anti-PD-1 treated vs 6 untreated melanoma biopsies, unpaired, single batch), with sample_01 at ~1/4 median depth. There are no raw counts, so count-based tools (DESeq2/edgeR/voom) are inapplicable — the whole workflow stays on TPM/log-TPM per R-0004. The research question is purely about immune/stromal composition and its difference between treated and control, so the plan is a QC -> filter -> multi-method deconvolution -> composition comparison sequence, with no unasked differential-expression-on-genes or pathway-enrichment scope added. Track 1 establishes sample structure and keeps sample_01 through QC with an explicit report rather than silent removal (R-0008). Track 2 runs the deconvolution: EPIC and quanTIseq for absolute immune/stromal fractions from TPM, MCP-counter and xCell as abundance/enrichment scores, and ConsensusTME for a tumor-microenvironment consensus, all through the immunedeconv interface where available, because CIBERSORT/LM22 and ESTIMATE are not distributed as open packages in this environment (R-0131, R-0130) and no method ranks first for every cell type (R-0128). Track 3 tests each cell-type score/fraction between treated and control with limma moderated t-tests (not GSVA-style bundling, per the knowledge check) and BH-adjusts across the cell types tested, then requires two-or-more-method agreement before any composition claim is reported as robust (R-0128). The final report states which claims are consensus-supported, flags sample_01's depth and its position in the QC ordination, and states which tool-of-record methods (CIBERSORT, ESTIMATE) were substituted and why.

steps.method: Sample structure QC on log2(TPM+1): PCA/MDS, sample distance heatmap, detected genes per sample
Low abundance filter on TPM matrix
immunedeconv multi-method consensus: EPIC + quanTIseq + MCP-counter + xCell + ConsensusTME
limma with trend=TRUE, robust eBayes, on log2(TPM+1) of composition scores/cell fractions (t-test/limma per cell type, treated vs control)
Between-groups comparison of immune/stromal cell composition fractions (EPIC/quanTIseq/MCP-counter/xCell/ConsensusTME outputs), treated vs control
limma per cell-type on the deconvolution fraction/score matrix (treated vs control), BH across cell types tested
limma linear model on log2(TPM+1), moderated t-test with robust+trend eBayes, treated vs control
